04 / THE PRACTICAL SIDE OF AI
Better questions.
Better automation.
A few useful starting points for your next leadership conversation.
01 / REVENUE
Which workflow should you automate first?
Read the field note ＋
Start with a frequent, repeatable workflow where delays have a visible business cost. Map inputs, exceptions and the person accountable for the result. Measure the current process before defining the automation.
02 / OPERATIONS
Where does a human stay in the loop?
Read the field note ＋
Keep human approval around sensitive decisions, irreversible actions and uncertain outputs. Automate the preparation and routing first. Expand autonomy only when the workflow can be measured and reviewed.
03 / LEADERSHIP
What should you measure beyond time saved?
Read the field note ＋
Track cycle time, error rates, rework and the actual business outcome. For sales, that might be response time and qualified pipeline. For operations, it might be turnaround time and exception volume.


05 / GOOD QUESTIONS
A little more clarity.
How much does a project cost?
Every workflow is scoped individually. Your systems, integrations, data readiness and approval requirements shape the quote. Start with the project brief so we can discuss the right scope.
Can you work with our existing tools?
We assess the APIs, permissions and data access available in your current systems. The goal is to improve the workflow you already use, with custom software where it adds value.
How quickly can we see a prototype?
We aim to prototype the core workflow early, once the requirements and necessary access are clear. Delivery timelines depend on the complexity and data involved.
How do you approach sensitive business data?
Data access, model providers, retention and review controls are discussed during scoping. Production requirements should be agreed before any sensitive data is connected.
Do you help our team adopt AI?
Yes. Corporate AI training and workflow-specific guidance help your team understand the tools, review outputs and apply AI in everyday work.
Is EzyBiz a live AI consultant?
This site’s EzyBiz guide uses preset workflow suggestions. It helps you shape a brief; it does not access your business data or perform a data-based audit.
